newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Oppenheimer on tobacco companies.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Oppenheimer on tobacco companies.

text.p: Oppenheimer & Co said it raised price targets and trimmed fiscal year 1998 earnings estimates for tobacco companies.
-- said raised the price target on Philip Morris Cos Inc to $64 from $46, raised RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp to $48 from $39 and increased B.A.T Industries Plc to $29 from $19.

-- assuming the $368.5 billion settlement reached last week is approved in its current form and assuming the $0.20 per pack federal excise tax rise on cigarettes is passed, said trimmed earnings estimates for fiscal 1998.

-- based on those two assumptions, said cut Philip Morris' fiscal 1998 earnings estimate by $0.33 a share to $3.19 a share, cut RJR Nabisco's by $0.79 a share to $2.68 a share, cut UST Inc by $0.47 a share to $2.28 a share. Also cut 1998 estimate for B.A.T Industries by $0.15 per ADR to $1.78 per ADR.
-- On Friday, tobacco companies reached a settlement with 40 states suing the industry and the public health community.
